notes: FleetComm 1.3 — a walkthrough and a real cam wall. NEW OPERATORS get a two-minute tour: it opens by itself the first time you launch, walks you from sign-in to your first transmission — the board, what TX and LSN do, LSN ALL and the 1MC, setting your PTT key (keyboard, mouse, or stick), cycling nets with PageUp/PageDown, the game overlay, chat — and marks the real control on screen at every step. SKIP any time; replay it from SYS ▸ HELP or the link on the sign-in card. HELMET CAMS now look like helmet cams: every feed carries a recorder burn-in — LIVE lamp, elapsed timer, callsign and operator name, fleet clock along the bottom — and when the operator on a feed keys up, their tile outlines green with a VOX lamp (your own goes vermilion). The wall sizes itself to the window so plates stay readable.
